_comment: Telemetry dictionary: the single source of truth for the GNC downlink packets.
web/js/gnc/gncPackets.generated.js and docs/telemetry/gnc_packets.md. Edit this file, then run
`python -I tools/telemetry/generate.py`. Everything is big-endian. Offsets are computed, never written here.
Field types: u8 u16 u32 f32 f64, pad (count = number of zero bytes), record:<name> (see records).
Field keys: name (camelCase, the key of the decoded console object), type, count (array length),
unit, description, enum (name in enums), bits (flag names for a u8, lowest bit first),
boolean (a u8 that is 0 or 1; decoded as a boolean), limits ({"yellow":[lo,hi],"red":[lo,hi]}).
TODO(phase 10, item 48): fill in per-field limits; the alarm logic of the consoles will use them. None are defined yet.

secondaryHeader._comment: Documentation only. The header is written by fsw/Ccsds.hpp, not generated.

constants.name: engineCount
constants.description: Sea-level Raptor 3 engines (gimbaled, inner ring); engine indices 0 to 2. The gimbal records and the guidance engine records cover only these.

constants.name: engineAzimuthFirstDeg
constants.description: Azimuth of engine 0 from body +x toward +y; engine i sits at this plus engineAzimuthStepDeg * i.

constants.name: engineRadius
constants.description: Engine distance from the vehicle axis.

constants.name: rvacCount
constants.description: Raptor Vacuum engines (fixed, no gimbal, outer ring); engine indices engineCount to engineCount + rvacCount - 1 in the engine status packet.

constants.name: rvacAzimuthFirstDeg
constants.description: Azimuth of the first RVac from body +x toward +y; RVac j sits at this plus rvacAzimuthStepDeg * j (60 deg off the sea-level engines).

constants.name: rvacRadius
constants.description: RVac distance from the vehicle axis.

gnc_engine.title: Engine command record
gnc_engine.description: Per-engine command in the guidance and control packet.

fields.name: throttle
fields.description: throttle command, fraction of rated flow

engine_power.title: Engine power record
engine_power.description: Per-engine power setting and measured state in the engine status packet (all six engines: sea-level 0 to 2, RVac 3 to 5).

fields.name: state
fields.description: engine controller state as reported by the engine (inhibited: commanded on but refused, e.g. RVac flow separation at high ambient pressure)

fields.name: command
fields.description: power setting command, fraction of rated flow (0 when commanded off)

fields.name: throttle
fields.description: actual throttle, measured by the engine feedback sensor (not the command)

feedback_engine.title: Engine gimbal feedback record
feedback_engine.description: Per-engine measured gimbal position in the actuator feedback packet.

fields.name: valid
fields.description: gimbal position sensor reading is valid

packets.name: fsw_status
packets.title: FSW status
packets.description: Flight software mode, health flags and counters.

packets.name: mission_config
packets.title: Mission config
packets.description: The target and hop parameters the flight software is configured with.

fields.name: translateAltitude
fields.description: altitude at which translation to the target starts

packets.name: navigation
packets.title: Navigation
packets.description: Estimates are the flight software's; "measured" values are the latest raw sensor readings.

fields.name: attitude
fields.description: components w, x, y, z; estimated, body to local ENU

fields.name: angularRate
fields.description: components x, y, z; measured (IMU), body

fields.name: specificForce
fields.description: components x, y, z; measured (IMU), body

fields.name: east
fields.description: estimated, IMU point in the target's ENU frame

fields.name: north
fields.description: estimated, IMU point in the target's ENU frame

fields.name: positionSigmaEast
fields.description: 1-sigma east position uncertainty, square root of the horizontal Kalman filter covariance diagonal; 0 until the filter starts

fields.name: positionSigmaNorth
fields.description: 1-sigma north position uncertainty, square root of the horizontal Kalman filter covariance diagonal; 0 until the filter starts

fields.name: velocitySigmaEast
fields.description: 1-sigma east velocity uncertainty, square root of the horizontal Kalman filter covariance diagonal; 0 until the filter starts

fields.name: velocitySigmaNorth
fields.description: 1-sigma north velocity uncertainty, square root of the horizontal Kalman filter covariance diagonal; 0 until the filter starts

fields.name: gnssInnovationEast
fields.description: latest GNSS east position innovation: measurement (lever arm corrected with the attitude of its time of validity) minus the filter prediction at that same time of validity (the fix is applied there, then replayed to now)

fields.name: gnssInnovationNorth
fields.description: latest GNSS north position innovation: measurement (lever arm corrected with the attitude of its time of validity) minus the filter prediction at that same time of validity (the fix is applied there, then replayed to now)

fields.name: altimeterInnovation
fields.description: latest altimeter residual: tilt-compensated measured altitude minus estimated altitude before the correction. The vertical estimator is a fixed-gain complementary filter, so there is no vertical sigma

fields.name: gnssUpdateAge
fields.description: time since the last accepted GNSS fix; -1 if none accepted yet. No measurement gating exists, so there is no rejected count

fields.name: altimeterUpdateAge
fields.description: time since the last accepted altimeter reading; -1 if none accepted yet. No measurement gating exists, so there is no rejected count

packets.name: guidance_control
packets.title: Guidance and control
packets.description: Guidance setpoints, control commands and the per-engine commands sent to the actuators.

packets.name: actuator_feedback
packets.title: Actuator feedback
packets.description: Measured gimbal positions from the gimbal position sensors (`GimbalFeedbackModel`).

packets.name: engine_status
packets.title: Engine status
packets.description: Power setting command, measured throttle and state of all six engines (three sea-level Raptors, then three Raptor Vacuums). A separate packet so the guidance and actuator feedback layouts (sea-level engines only) are unchanged.

fields.name: engines
fields.description: per engine; index 0 to 2 sea-level, 3 to 5 RVac

packets.name: gnss
packets.title: GNSS
packets.description: The latest receiver solution as the flight computer received it.

fields.name: fixTime
fields.description: time of validity, flight computer time

fields.name: velocity
fields.description: east, north, up at the antenna

packets.name: catch_status
packets.title: Catch status
packets.description: Catch state computed by the flight software (phase, abort reason, go/no-go flags and the errors against the seat). The Ship translates to a point over the seat early and descends vertically between the open arms, so the phases Approach, Hold and Final are height bands of one vertical descent (Hold = the arms are expected to be closing). The arm state is NOT downlinked to the flight computer: armsExpected is what the sequence expects (time since the arms-closing height), not a measurement. Along and lateral are the horizontal offset from the seat point in the tower approach frame: alongRemaining positive = short of the seat point, lateral positive toward the +b side (b = approach direction rotated +90 deg). The go/no-go flags are the flight software gates (about 2x the physical catch window, tapering with height above the seat), not the window itself. The u8 block is 4 bytes so every f32 is 4-byte aligned.

fields.name: abortReason
fields.description: reason for the last abort; 0 if none

fields.name: armsExpected
fields.description: arm state expected per the sequence (time since the arms-closing height), not measured

bits.name: positionOk
bits.description: horizontal error to the seat within the funnel for this height

bits.name: speedOk
bits.description: horizontal speed and sink rate within their gates for this height

bits.name: tiltOk
bits.description: tilt and heading within their gates for this height

bits.name: corridorOk
bits.description: lateral error inside the funnel for this height

bits.name: aborted
bits.description: catch aborted, flying the pad fallback

fields.name: alongRemaining
fields.description: horizontal offset along the approach axis from the seat point; positive = short of the seat (the Ship descends over the seat, so this is near zero in a good run)

fields.name: lateralError
fields.description: lateral offset from the seat point; positive = +b side

fields.name: pinHeightAboveSeat
fields.description: catch pin height above the seated pin height

fields.name: alongSpeed
fields.description: estimated horizontal velocity along the approach axis

fields.name: lateralLimit
fields.description: funnel: horizontal error allowed at the current height above the seat (about 1.2 m at the seat, widening with height)

fields.name: timeToSeat
fields.description: estimated time to the seat from the vertical motion (constant deceleration from the sink rate to the contact sink rate); -1 if not descending

packets.name: catch_config
packets.title: Catch config
packets.description: Catch geometry and window limits the flight software is configured with (mission data). Target-frame local ENU, metres and radians. The u8 is followed by 3 pad bytes so every f32 is 4-byte aligned.

fields.name: seatPoint
fields.description: east, north, seated base altitude; target frame

fields.name: approachDir
fields.description: unit vector east, north, toward the tower from the approach side (defines along and lateral)

fields.name: stagingDistance
fields.description: distance of the translation target before the seat point along the approach axis; 0 = the Ship translates to a point straight over the seat and descends vertically

fields.name: hingeHalfSpacing
fields.description: arm hinge lateral offset from the approach axis

fields.name: hingeSetback
fields.description: arm hinge distance from the tower center along the approach axis

fields.name: armOpenAngle
fields.description: open arm direction, outward from the approach axis

fields.name: armClosedAngle
fields.description: closed arm direction, inward from the approach axis
